observations: A large dark circular form dominates the center, ringed with short radiating spikes; inside it, two eye-like shapes hold an X-crossed blue circle on the left and a green rectangle on the right.
Jagged crown-like points rise above the circle in red, yellow, and blue outlines, while a yellow rectangular mouth zone near the bottom contains white letter-like marks.
The olive-gold background carries looping yellow lines, dark brown grid marks, and scattered red strokes; a blue spiral sits in the lower right corner.
reading: The dark central form reads as a face under pressure: its crossed eye and mismatched green socket create asymmetry rather than calm. The spiked crown above and the toothed mouth below frame it as something between authority and alarm. Yellow loops crowd the background without resolving into legible marks, keeping the surrounding space restless. The collector's link to scrimshaw feels apt — dense line-work etched into a dark ground.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, #237 sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #236 and nnxyz nnotb #238. Where #236 uses a cool gray field and #238 burns with flat orange, #237 settles on an olive-gold ground — a middle temperature between those two owned works.
